summary: Iteration-2 testing complete. Backend: all 7 new-feature pytest tests pass (formations CRUD + default P1-P6, extra fundamentos Contra-ataque/Cobertura/Continuidade, archive endpoints with history preserved, new action fields set_number/formation/result/court/clip_start/clip_end persisted via POST+GET+PUT, rally link/unlink with phase propagation + delete rally unlinks + phase filter). AI endpoint test SKIPPED — returns 502 because Emergent LLM key budget is exceeded (LiteLLM RateLimitError 'Current cost: 0.014924, Max budget: 0.001'); the backend code path is correct and raises 502 with a clear message as designed. Frontend: Analyze workspace fully working — 9 quick-mark buttons render, clicking one opens the draft edit panel with court-map (9-zone SVG), mark-set/mark-formation/mark-phase/mark-result/set-start-now/set-end-now/preview-clip controls all present, clicking court places point, Salvar creates new lance (timeline went 10→11), rally linking shows situation+Relacionar button and 'Jogada relacionada' toast on click. Reports page has all 4 tabs (rtab-geral/recepcao/formacao/mapa) and switches correctly. AI page has ai-question/ai-send/ai-suggestion-0; clicking suggestion+send does not render ai-result (as expected due to 502). Settings: Formações tab adds formation (toast 'Formação criada'), Fundamentos tab shows 9 archive-fund-* buttons and toggle-archived.

minor.issue: Returns 502 due to Emergent LLM key budget exceeded (RateLimitError: Max budget 0.001 USD). Not a code bug — environment limitation. Model configured is 'claude-sonnet-5-5' per spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid 'clear-court' on the 'limpar' court-reset button (the button exists visually as 'limpar' near the court-map but has no clear-court testid)

integration_issues.issue: ai-result block never renders because /api/ai/analyze returns 502 due to Emergent key budget exceeded. Not a frontend bug.

action_items: Add data-testid="clear-court" to the 'limpar' button inside the court-map section of Analyze draft panel (minor).
Top-up / rotate the Emergent LLM key budget to re-enable /api/ai/analyze (environment, not code).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 794 lines — split into routers/services modules is overdue.
/api/rallies/link: when situation is None, phase of linked actions is overwritten to None, which can wipe pre-existing phases. Consider only updating phase when situation is provided.

update() helper copies the input payload including auto fields; PUT on actions re-sends full ActionIn so clip_start/clip_end can be nulled accidentally — PATCH endpoint for partial updates would be safer.
list_fundamentos / list_classificacoes return ALL docs including archived; frontend has a toggle but server has no ?include_archived param — add one for API consumers.
No unit test coverage for the AI code path (build_stats) in isolation; add a test that calls build_stats() directly to validate stats shape without hitting the LLM.

success_rate.backend: 100% of testable (7/7; 1 AI test skipped due to env budget)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-2 flows (AI result blocked by backend 502)
